postChangeResults.source: 10-seed indicative local sweep (seeds 1-10, all 3 ideas applied, weapon_personas=true)

throwing-knife.note: indicative; 1 timeout seed2, 1 death seed7 lv4

ideas.name: Raise ranged weapon persona constitution minimums
ideas.hypothesis: The AI stat allocator fills minimumTargets first. Ranged personas had constitution min 5-6 vs melee 6-7. AvgMinHP of 45-46% for ranged vs 71-75% for melee indicates HP starvation. Raising bow/pistol 5→7 and throwing-knife 6→7 adds 20 HP (+13%), closing the survivability gap. Combined with gear scoring bias toward constitution items — treated as intentional persona treatment.
ideas.telemetryEvidence: Clear correlation in baseline: melee (con min 6-7) → 92-100% win rate; ranged (con min 5-6) → 72-76% win rate. All three ranged show AvgMinHP ~45-47% vs melee 71-75%.
ideas.change: bow minimumTargets.constitution: 5→7; pistol minimumTargets.constitution: 5→7; throwing-knife minimumTargets.constitution: 6→7

attempts.note: Part of combined 3-idea sweep. Full isolated sweep pending.
attempts.rationale: All three ranged weapons improved. Bow went from 72%→100%, pistol 72%→90%. AvgMinHP improvements across all weapons confirm the constitution boost directly addresses HP starvation. Throwing-knife at 80% still below 90% target but significantly improved. Combined effects from Ideas 2 and 3 also contributed.

ideas.name: Increase player invincibility frames (250ms→350ms)
ideas.hypothesis: Player invincibility window prevents stacking damage from multiple hits. Deaths at lv3-4 (120-153s) occur during dense early enemy packs. Extending iframes from 250→350ms (40% increase) breaks damage-stacking chains from rats/slimes. Applied in damageSystem.ts PLAYER_INVINCIBILITY_MS constant (NOT tuning.json — that field is unread by combat systems).
ideas.telemetryEvidence: Early deaths at seeds 12/48/52 at lv3-4, 120-153s — timing consistent with dense early-game mob packs before HP pool is built up.

attempts.note: Part of combined 3-idea sweep. Full isolated sweep pending.
attempts.rationale: AvgMinHP improvements across all weapons (including fireball: 57.4%→63.4%, sword: 75%→76.2%, bat: 71.1%→80.7%) are consistent with reduced damage stacking. Improvement is not exclusive to ranged, supporting the global invincibility frame mechanism.

ideas.name: Reduce Rat Brute contact damage (10→7)
ideas.hypothesis: Rat Brutes appear 15% of passive spawns and 40% of defensive spawns. Contact damage 10 (2.5× regular rat) causes spiky damage events. Reducing from 10→7 (30% reduction) makes them still dangerous but less likely to cause one-two-punch kills. Targets actual Floor 1 mob; the DEFAULT_CONTACT_DAMAGE fallback in damageSystem.ts doesn't affect real mobs.
ideas.telemetryEvidence: Early deaths at lv3-4 in Rats Nest encounters. With con 5 player (150 HP), a brute hit was 6.7% HP per contact in swarms.

attempts.note: Part of combined 3-idea sweep. Full isolated sweep pending.
attempts.rationale: Combined with Ideas 1+2, the bat improvement (71.1%→80.7% avgMinHP) and sword improvement (75%→76.2%) — both of which don't benefit from constitution changes — are consistent with the rat brute damage reduction being a contributing factor. Effect cannot be perfectly isolated from the combined sweep, but the directional signal is positive.

combinedSweep.strategy: All 3 ideas implemented cumulatively in one commit. Combined 10-seed indicative local sweep provides early directional signal. Full 100-seed canonical sweep via GitHub Actions workflow_dispatch needed for final judgment — dispatch command: gh workflow run weapon-sweep.yml --ref copilot/balance-telemetry-driven-improvement-sweep -f weapon_personas=true -f seed_count=100

finalJudge.rationale: All 3 ideas show positive directional signal in the 10-seed indicative sweep. Ranged weapons improved dramatically: bow +28pp, pistol +18pp, throwing-knife +4pp. Melee weapons also improved (bat +8pp winRate, +9.6pp avgMinHP). No regressions observed. AvgMinHP improvements across ALL weapons confirm reduced damage stacking and better early-game HP management. Throwing-knife at 80% (10-seed indicative) is still below the 90% target — full canonical sweep needed to confirm if it's above 90% with 100 seeds. RECOMMENDED for merge pending @nalfeo's explicit APPROVED FOR CHECK-IN approval and canonical sweep confirmation.
